moves.name: Top Performer Ceaseless Edge
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] applies to the opponent’s field of play.
Deactivation Condition:
When the opponent’s field of play is no longer [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ].

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. This move’s power increases when successfully used in succession. (This move powers up by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]% every time it is used.) (The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="2" ]%.) If a different move is used by the user’s Pokémon, this move’s power returns to normal.
